name: Akpu
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Peel the cassava tubers and wash thoroughly.
Place the cassava in a container and cover completely with water.
Allow it to ferment for 3–4 days or until softened.
Remove any fibres and hard portions from the fermented cassava.
Mash the cassava and sieve to obtain a smooth paste.
Suspend the paste in a clean cloth or sack and allow excess water to drain.
Transfer the fermented cassava paste into a pot.
Cook over medium heat while stirring continuously until a smooth, stretchy dough forms.
Shape into portions and serve hot with soup.

culture.text: Fufu is a pounded meal found in West African cuisine originally made from boiled cassava, plantains, and cocoyam. Fufu's prevalence in West Africa has been noted in local literature, such as Chinua Achebe's Things Fall Apart.
